ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast with approximately 80% low-intensity (black) pixel coverage and 20% high-intensity (white) localized clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity contiguous white clusters at the distal tips of both lobes. Significant white micro-speckling (mottling) distributed across the central and lower ventral surface. Two distinct circular high-contrast focal spots located on the mid-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped depression with an approximate calculated pixel angle of 42 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge; peaks show variable amplitudes between 10-30 pixels, with more pronounced jaggedness on the left lobe edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex mathematical curve fitting the trailing edge from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular high-contrast white pixel groups located at the extreme distal tips and along the lateral edges, consistent with heavy barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned white linear pixel disruptions; notably a series of parallel diagonal rake marks on the lower left lobe and a prominent horizontal scratch in the lower center.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified barnacle clusters at the tips; irregular, jagged loss of tissue on the extreme outer edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced three-dimensional calcified projections extending beyond the anatomical trailing edge boundary at the fluke tips.
